# @ultime/checks

> 适用版本：0.1.x
> 仓库约束检测工具：CLI 与 Node API，规则由配置注入；运行时零依赖。

## 文档

- [README.md](./README.md)
- [USAGE.md](./USAGE.md)
- [SKILLS.md](./SKILLS.md)
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [规则：doc-set](./docs/rules/doc-set.md)
- [规则：docs](./docs/rules/docs.md)
- [规则：imports](./docs/rules/imports.md)
- [规则：unresolved](./docs/rules/unresolved.md)
- [规则：cycles](./docs/rules/cycles.md)
- [规则：text](./docs/rules/text.md)

## 入口

- 配置：`checks.config.mjs`
- CLI：`checks run` / `checks rules` / `checks explain <rule>`
- Node API：`import { createChecker } from '@ultime/checks'`
